# sailpoint_source_correlation_config (Resource)

Manages the correlation configuration for a SailPoint source. Correlation config determines how incoming account data is matched to known identities. 

This is a singleton-per-source resource using an adopt-only lifecycle: Create reads the existing config and applies any declared changes, Update replaces the config via PUT, and Delete is a no-op that only removes the resource from Terraform state (the config always exists on the server).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Correlation config for an Active Directory source.
#
# Correlation determines how incoming account records are matched to known
# identities. The most common pattern is to correlate by a unique account
# attribute (e.g. sAMAccountName) against a unique identity attribute (e.g. uid).
#
# This is a singleton-per-source resource. Create adopts the existing config
# (it always exists for a source) and Delete is a no-op — removing this resource
# from Terraform only removes it from Terraform state; the config persists in ISC.
resource "sailpoint_source_correlation_config" "ad" {
  source_id = sailpoint_source.ad.id

  attribute_assignments = [
    {
      property  = "sAMAccountName"
      value     = "uid"
      operation = "EQ"
    },
  ]
}

# Import an existing correlation config into Terraform state:
#   terraform import sailpoint_source_correlation_config.ad <source-id>
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `attribute_assignments` (Attributes List) List of account-to-identity attribute mappings that drive correlation. Each entry maps a source account attribute (`property`) to an identity attribute (`value`). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--attribute_assignments))
- `source_id` (String) The ID of the source whose correlation config is being managed.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource identifier — mirrors `source_id` for import convenience.
- `name` (String) Server-assigned name of the correlation config (e.g. `AD Correlation Config`).

<a id="nestedatt--attribute_assignments"></a>
### Nested Schema for `attribute_assignments`

Required:

- `property` (String) The source account attribute name (e.g. `sAMAccountName`).
- `value` (String) The identity attribute name to correlate against (e.g. `uid`).

Optional:

- `complex` (Boolean) Whether the assignment uses a complex expression. Server-resolved when not set.
- `filter_string` (String) An additional filter expression applied to candidate accounts before correlation.
- `ignore_case` (Boolean) Whether the comparison is case-insensitive.
- `match_mode` (String) Match mode for string comparisons (e.g. `ANYWHERE`, `START`, `END`, `EXACT`).
- `operation` (String) Comparison operation. Defaults to `EQ`.
